The '''Yarin language''' was spoken by members of the treelike [[Yarin/Legends|Yarin]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. One Yarin word was "''elfa''" which meant "fish so small, it's not worth catching." The [[Yarin Harbormaster]] on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] named his submersible ''[[Elfa]]''.
